# Apache config sample Listen 80 ServerName example.com <VirtualHost *:80> DocumentRoot "/var/www/html" <Directory "/var/www/html"> Options Indexes FollowSymLinks AllowOverride All Require all granted </Directory> ErrorDocument 404 /404.html RewriteEngine on RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.(.+)$ [NC] RewriteRule ^ http://%1%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301] </VirtualHost>
